## What We Heard
- "we are drowning in alerts and most of them are noise"
- Analysts spend 30-40 minutes per alert pivoting across four consoles.

## What We'll Show You
We'll walk through how an analyst on your SOC goes from a noisy alert queue to a single investigation, with a guided explanation of each alert and a fast pivot into the related activity.

## How We Define a Successful Evaluation
We'll know this demonstration has hit the mark when you can see:
1. A junior analyst gets a plain-language explanation of an alert and the next step.
2. Related alerts come together in one investigation.

These are the outcomes we're designing toward. We'll close the session by reviewing each one together.
